home.summary: Islamic learning, a free daily lunch and a neighbourhood clinic at Jama Masjid Al-Azeem in Sahiwal.

about.label: About the Markaz
about.heading: A place to learn, pray and serve
about.body: Founded in 2019, Markaz Al Azeem is a madrasa at Jama Masjid Al-Azeem. Alongside the madrasa’s teaching, the Markaz runs a daily community lunch and a local clinic.

education.title: Islamic education
education.body: Students learn at the madrasa, with residential facilities for those who live on site.

meals.title: Community kitchen
meals.body: The kitchen prepares and serves a free lunch every day.

clinic.title: Local clinic
clinic.body: The clinic sees patients from the surrounding community.

story.missionHeading: Learning, prayer, and a meal for whoever comes
story.missionBody: Markaz Al Azeem opened in 2019 at Jama Masjid Al-Azeem, on 92/6-R Road in Sahiwal. Students study at the madrasa, the kitchen serves a free lunch every day, and a clinic sees people from the neighbourhood. A gift is recorded when it arrives, then matched to spending so you can see what it paid for.
story.heroHeadline: See where your gift is spent.
story.heroTagline: Learning, a daily meal, and care beside Jama Masjid Al-Azeem.
story.educationBody: Students memorise the Qur'an and study the Dars-e-Nizami course, with rooms for those who live at the madrasa.
story.mealsBody: The kitchen prepares a free lunch and serves it every day. The number is the institute’s published figure for people served.
story.clinicBody: The clinic sees patients from the surrounding area. Donors can support it as a cause. This site does not keep patient records.
story.orphansBody: A sponsor can be matched to a student the institute has recorded as an orphan. Until two staff members sign consent, the sponsor sees a persona, an age and progress notes only. There is no direct contact with the child.
story.flowHeading: From your bank to a recorded use
story.flow1Body: Pick Zakat, Sadaqah or a general gift, then a cause or all needs.
story.flow2Body: Send the amount to the account published on the donate page. Check the account title in your own banking app.
story.flow3Body: Leave your email. An account is not required. The office matches your note to the bank credit.
story.flow4Body: After confirmation you receive a private link. Spending draws on the oldest gifts in that cause first, and your trail shows your share.
story.zakatHeading: Two kinds of giving, kept apart
story.zakatBody: Zakat is the obligatory alms. On this site it can go only to causes the institute has marked as accepting Zakat. The site does not decide that mark, and it does not issue a ruling.
story.sadaqahBody: Sadaqah is a voluntary gift. It can support any open cause, including work that Zakat may not pay for.
story.generalBody: A general gift is recorded without a Zakat intention, so the two are not mixed in the ledger.
story.verseArabic: مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ حَبَّةٍ أَنبَتَتْ سَبْعَ سَنَابِلَ فِي كُلِّ سُنبُلَةٍ مِّائَةُ حَبَّةٍ ۗ وَاللَّهُ يُضَاعِفُ لِمَن يَشَاءُ ۗ وَاللَّهُ وَاسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ
story.verseText: The likeness of those who spend their wealth in Allah's way is as the likeness of a grain which groweth seven ears, in every ear a hundred grains. Allah giveth increase manifold to whom He will. Allah is All-Embracing, All-Knowing.
story.quote1: I could see the account title, send the transfer myself, and later open a link that showed where the gift was spent.
story.quote2: The lunch is served every day. Families nearby know they can sit and eat.
story.quote3: I wanted my Zakat kept with causes marked for Zakat, and the page made that choice plain.
story.faq1A: No. An email is enough to tell the office about a transfer. You can open a donor account later and gather your gifts there.
story.faq2Q: How will I know the money arrived?
story.faq2A: The office confirms the transfer against the bank, then emails a private link. Until then the gift is a notice, not a recorded donation.
story.faq3A: Only if you choose Zakat and a cause the institute has marked as accepting it. If you are unsure, choose Sadaqah or ask the office. This site does not issue a ruling.
story.faq4A: Legal registration is in progress. Donations are not yet tax-deductible.
story.faq5A: The address is Jama Masjid Al-Azeem, 92/6-R Road, Sahiwal. Use the map, or contact the office before you travel.
story.hoursBody: After Zuhr until Asr, Saturday to Thursday.
story.mapTitle: Map of the published address, Jama Masjid Al-Azeem, Sahiwal
story.ctaBody: Copy the account details, send the amount from your own bank, and tell the office. We confirm the credit and email you a private trail.

footer.tagline: A record of every gift, from the transfer to the spending.
